reconstruction: Synthetic case-local GPS and timestamps fitted to the pre-existing plotted summaries; not recovered WorldTrace observations or road-matched tracks.

metric_definitions.distance_meters: sum of consecutive-point haversine distances, R=6371008.8 m
metric_definitions.avg_speed_kmh: total GPS distance / elapsed timestamp duration * 3.6
metric_definitions.detour_score: total GPS distance / endpoint haversine distance
metric_definitions.mean_yaw_change_deg: mean absolute wrapped change of consecutive GPS segment bearings; horizontal heading-change proxy, not measured IMU yaw

historical_source_trajectory_id_note: Retained identifiers in sample 04 document old summary lineage only; reconstructed coordinates are not the original trajectories.
geographic_note: Region labels use the existing approximate NYC bounding-box convention, not official administrative polygons. These synthetic paths are not road-map matched.
quality_constraint_exception: Existing plotted summary values are explicitly preserved at user request. New point positions, motion and sampling profiles vary across every trajectory.
distance_adjustment_note: Four synthetic cold-rain car tracks were lengthened at user request to leave six short, four medium and two long tracks. Point counts, mean speeds, detour and mean heading change are preserved; GPS and timestamp durations are adjusted consistently. All original insight text is preserved.
